title: Follow-up run: Bundled ChartSearchAI vs. Med Agent Hub on one shared 12B engine
summary: A repeat of the 17-question HIV chart comparison across three patients, running all three setups through the same Gemma 4 12B model: ChartSearchAI's built-in answer path on its default settings, Med Agent Hub's plain answer path, and Med Agent Hub's checked profile (which reviews each answer and flags unsupported claims).
takeaway: Both Med Agent Hub setups (82.0 checked, 81.6 answer-only) outscored built-in ChartSearchAI (55.2) by more than 26 points on the exact same model. Built-in ChartSearchAI struggled with date calculations (8 date errors vs. 0 on the Hub) because it does not pass today's reference date or run deterministic date and guideline checks.
